card.name: Spaces before numbers in ranges
card.fires_on: Mostly the space just before a number that ends a range or threshold, such as 'to 12 hours', 'days 3 and 7' or '≥ 240 mg/dL'. Also fires on scattered small word parts in label text.

modes.label: Space before range number
modes.description: A space token right before the second number of a time range or a lab threshold.

modes.label: Scattered mid-word pieces
modes.description: Partway through words or small linking words in label prose.
